title: multi use, attractive, one of my dividers came off
text:
multi use, attractive, one of my dividers came off. One of the metal dividers broke off on mine. It doesn't impede use or overall look, as it can be set back into place- though to keep it there it will need to be glued. I had been trying out different locations and different stuff when it just came off.

I decided on use for my office. I wont use the front shallow compartment for holding my cellphone as I have no need for that, and I have a wallet cover on my phone anyway. I instead have a small notepad and a stack of sticky notes leaning in there. It could be used to toss change, jewelry, paper clips, container of dental floss, other odds and ends. Remainder of space has some pens, pencils and scissors.

The drain plug at the bottom could be helpful if you are using it as a toothbrush holder. Can drain any liquid build up- but why not just pour it out? With the dividers, I am not sure how you would clean the inside. The dividers are glued down- well, one of mine is anyway. So I am not entirely convinced of overall functionality of drain plug. I like the idea though.

Also along bottom are 4 tiny pads- one in each corner. To protect what it is sitting on, or to help keep it in place. Nice detail.

If it weren't for the broken piece, I would give it 4 stars. It just popped off too easy, and I don't know if I did it, or if it was kinda loose to begin with. Either way, I have a chipped product.
